'''Reina''' (Japanese: '''レイナ''' ''Reina'') is a recurring character in [[Pokémon Origins]] and a volunteer at the [[Lavender Volunteer Pokémon House]].

==History==
Reina first appeared in ''[[PO02|File 2: Cubone]]'', where she met {{OBP|Red|Origins}} at [[Mr. Fuji]]'s Pokémon House. She explained to Red who Mr. Fuji is and what the Pokémon House is for. She also told him about an orphaned {{p|Cubone}} whose mother was killed by [[Team Rocket]]. After finding out that Mr. Fuji was being held captive in the Pokémon Tower, she tried to think of a way to rescue him. When the townspeople stated that they are too scared of Team Rocket, as well as the ghosts living inside the tower, to rescue Mr. Fuji, she berated them for being too cowardly. 

Later, she heard {{p|Cubone}} going crazy inside its playpen and went over to check it. However, once she unlocked the door, Cubone escaped and ran off into the Pokémon Tower. She followed Cubone and helped keep it calm when it confronted Team Rocket. After Team Rocket was defeated, she saw Red off alongside the other townspeople.

In ''[[PO04|File 4: Charizard]]'', she worriedly informed Mr. Fuji that Red had gone to face {{p|Mewtwo}} inside [[Cerulean Cave]]. When Mr. Fuji said that Red might not be able to win, she became fearful for her friend.

Cubone embraced its mother one last time, which allowed her to calm down enough and pass on to the afterlife. Afterward, it helped Red battle against Team Rocket and saw him off when he left to continue his journey.

Cubone's only known move is {{m|Bonemerang}}.}}

==In the games==
Reina appears in the [[Generation I]] and [[Generation II]]  games and their remakes as a nameless NPC in Mr. Fuji's house. She is apparently [[Mr. Fuji]]'s granddaughter.
